scope: Local pre-release validation. Hosted validation and exact-head CI are separate release steps.

postgres.database: Disposable local PostgreSQL 16, synthetic identities; hosted auth schema permissions mirrored

liveProvider.data: Local synthetic database; users removed after each run

regressions: Stop and provider interruption discard partial replies and exclude them from memory
No raw tool arguments or unverified source text rendered
Composer works while profile/history is blocked
Partial plan generation has no apply button
Plan preview, edit, double click, lost-response recovery, stale context and owner isolation
knownLimits: Small samples, not P95 or concurrency capacity
Providers that reorder reply arguments may deliver only a complete answer
Plan previews remain atomic and require confirmation
